game.title: Arizona Cardinals at Los Angeles Rams

lede: Los Angeles Rams carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#4 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Los Angeles Rams -7.3 with a fair total of 50.5, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Los Angeles Rams pass offence vs Arizona Cardinals pass defence, which sits +0.268 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Arizona Cardinals and Los Angeles Rams have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
